items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I know Basie played with him, and he played with Benny Morton. That's where Basie -- Basie was a piano player, and -- just a piano player in Benny Morton's band.

ctx.x: Tricky Sam and those kind of people. That man has some of the greatest jazz musicians that I ever knew, and I knew them all, well, very well. Back to Lips Page. I don't know whether Lips played with Duke. I know Basie played with him, and he played with Benny Morton. That's where Basie -- Basie was a piano player, and -- just a piano player in Benny Morton's band. He took over when Morton died. And then same one of the greatest swing bands in the land.]
